preconditions.description: The number of good letters is between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(letter in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for letter in good_letters)
preconditions.description: All good letters are distinct lowercase English letters.
The length of the pattern is between 1 and 100,000.
The pattern contains at most one '*' character.

preconditions.expression: all(letter in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?*' for letter in pattern)
preconditions.description: The pattern consists of lowercase English letters, '?' and '*' characters.
The number of query strings is between 1 and 100,000.
The total length of all query strings is not greater than 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(letter in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for letter in query) for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of query strings.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((result[i] == 'YES' if matches(pattern, good_letters, queries[i]) else result[i] == 'NO') for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The i-th output line is 'YES' if the pattern matches the i-th query string, otherwise 'NO'.
